_comment: Baseline medians for the indexing criterion bench on ubuntu-latest. Generated from GitHub Actions run 25188571600 on 2026-04-30 (codesurgeon@0c042cc — post PR #97 + #98). Regenerate by running `gh workflow run Bench --ref main`, then download the bench-results artifact and read median.point_estimate / mean.point_estimate from each criterion estimates.json. scripts/bench_summary.py reads this to compute Δ vs baseline for PR comments. Advisory only — no CI gate.
